_about: Public-domain Martin John Spalding (1810-1872, Bishop of Louisville, Archbishop of Baltimore) for the Word Hoard: the General Evidences of Catholicity (1847), the History of the Protestant Reformation (2 vols, 1860) and the Miscellanea (second edition, 1855), from Internet Archive scans. Written in English. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
